rv.pattern.offer.text: The Legion kept a pattern for strong tool heads in the western stores. With that, I can make tools that last. We need to build homes again, not just sharper swords.

voice.speaker: anvil
voice.direction: Plain, practical, warm. Let the small joke land without turning the request into a gag.
voice.context: Optional return request after ember. This helps ordinary people rebuild. No new Bladeborn revelation.

rv.pattern.later.text: Then do that first. This can wait. I am asking for a favor, not sending you to your doom on a shopping trip.

choices.text: Actually, tell me where to look.

voice.speaker: anvil
voice.direction: Plain, practical, warm. Let the small joke land without turning the request into a gag.
voice.context: Optional return request after ember. This helps ordinary people rebuild. No new Bladeborn revelation.

rv.pattern.accepted.text: The pattern box is in the western stores of Iron Halls. Its plate should explain the cooling wheel and clamp. Reach the Great Furnace before you head home; that gives us a safe route to carry it out.

voice.speaker: anvil
voice.direction: Plain, practical, warm. Let the small joke land without turning the request into a gag.
voice.context: Optional return request after ember. This helps ordinary people rebuild. No new Bladeborn revelation.

rv.pattern.wait.text: Still looking? Western stores, Iron Halls. Cool the box before you open it. Finish that half, then bring the pattern here.

voice.speaker: anvil
voice.direction: Plain, practical, warm. Let the small joke land without turning the request into a gag.
voice.context: Optional return request after ember. This helps ordinary people rebuild. No new Bladeborn revelation.

rv.pattern.deliver.text: Is that the pattern? Let me see. Yes. A proper working edge. These tools will be useful long after the fighting stops.

voice.speaker: anvil
voice.direction: Plain, practical, warm. Let the small joke land without turning the request into a gag.
voice.context: Optional return request after ember. This helps ordinary people rebuild. No new Bladeborn revelation.

rv.pattern.thanks.text: Look beside the forge. The first tools are already laid out. Take 450 gold for the trip. You brought back something that helps people live.

voice.speaker: anvil
voice.direction: Plain, practical, warm. Let the small joke land without turning the request into a gag.
voice.context: Optional return request after ember. This helps ordinary people rebuild. No new Bladeborn revelation.

rv.supplies.offer.text: The rescued prisoners marked a sealed store in the western chamber. There is food inside. Good food, if the rats have not learned to use a hoist. I would rather our neighbors got it.

voice.speaker: quartermaster
voice.direction: Plain, practical, warm. Let the small joke land without turning the request into a gag.
voice.context: Optional return request after keep. This helps ordinary people rebuild. No new Bladeborn revelation.

rv.supplies.later.text: Then do that first. This can wait. I am asking for a favor, not sending you to your doom on a shopping trip.

choices.text: Actually, tell me where to look.

voice.speaker: quartermaster
voice.direction: Plain, practical, warm. Let the small joke land without turning the request into a gag.
voice.context: Optional return request after keep. This helps ordinary people rebuild. No new Bladeborn revelation.

rv.supplies.accepted.text: Go to the western sealed chamber in Broken Walls. Check the hoist plate, then lower the supplies. Reach the Dungeons before heading home so the load can get out safely.

voice.speaker: quartermaster
voice.direction: Plain, practical, warm. Let the small joke land without turning the request into a gag.
voice.context: Optional return request after keep. This helps ordinary people rebuild. No new Bladeborn revelation.

rv.supplies.wait.text: Western chamber, Broken Walls. The hoist needs the right balance. Finish that half, then bring the supplies here.

voice.speaker: quartermaster
voice.direction: Plain, practical, warm. Let the small joke land without turning the request into a gag.
voice.context: Optional return request after keep. This helps ordinary people rebuild. No new Bladeborn revelation.

rv.supplies.deliver.text: You got it here in one piece. So did the food. An excellent day for everyone except the rats.

voice.speaker: quartermaster
voice.direction: Plain, practical, warm. Let the small joke land without turning the request into a gag.
voice.context: Optional return request after keep. This helps ordinary people rebuild. No new Bladeborn revelation.

rv.supplies.thanks.text: The shelves are stocked again. Take 300 gold. And if anyone asks, yes, I did count every sack. Twice.

voice.speaker: quartermaster
voice.direction: Plain, practical, warm. Let the small joke land without turning the request into a gag.
voice.context: Optional return request after keep. This helps ordinary people rebuild. No new Bladeborn revelation.

rv.tracks.offer.text: You brought one frightened creature home. I reckon you have room to help two more. Fresh paw marks lead west from the old grove in Black Woods. There are abandoned traps out there. Nobody has gone back to check them.

voice.speaker: beastkeeper
voice.direction: Warm, plain speech. Practical animal care, with dry humor. Keep the concern sincere.
voice.context: Optional return visit. Abandoned traps threaten living animals. This is not a Hollowing or mount quest.

rv.tracks.later.text: They are off the main path. Keep it in mind when you have a safe chance. I will put clean bedding aside. Hope is useful. Dry bedding is better.

choices.text: Actually, tell me where to look.

voice.speaker: beastkeeper
voice.direction: Warm, plain speech. Practical animal care, with dry humor. Keep the concern sincere.
voice.context: Optional return visit. Abandoned traps threaten living animals. This is not a Hollowing or mount quest.

rv.tracks.accepted.text: Follow the paw marks west of the old grove. One trail climbs the low logs. The other stays near the roots. Free both animals, finish Black Woods, then tell me what you found.

voice.speaker: beastkeeper
voice.direction: Warm, plain speech. Practical animal care, with dry humor. Keep the concern sincere.
voice.context: Optional return visit. Abandoned traps threaten living animals. This is not a Hollowing or mount quest.

rv.tracks.wait.text: Look for round pads with four toes. A split hoof belongs to a deer. Check the roots and the old raised cage. You do not need to take your own companion into danger.

voice.speaker: beastkeeper
voice.direction: Warm, plain speech. Practical animal care, with dry humor. Keep the concern sincere.
voice.context: Optional return visit. Abandoned traps threaten living animals. This is not a Hollowing or mount quest.

rv.tracks.deliver.text: Both free? Good. I will get them settled and teach our companions a little better care. A dry shelter, clean dressings, a proper meal. Heroes need those too, despite the rumors.

choices.text: They are both out of the traps.

voice.speaker: beastkeeper
voice.direction: Warm, plain speech. Practical animal care, with dry humor. Keep the concern sincere.
voice.context: Optional return visit. Abandoned traps threaten living animals. This is not a Hollowing or mount quest.

rv.tracks.thanks.text: The care shelter is ready. Every companion you equip now has ten percent more maximum health. No bill. You did the hard part.

voice.speaker: beastkeeper
voice.direction: Warm, plain speech. Practical animal care, with dry humor. Keep the concern sincere.
voice.context: Optional return visit. Abandoned traps threaten living animals. This is not a Hollowing or mount quest.

rv.keepsake.offer.text: Word reached me about the people you helped at the Keep. I came to see for myself that you still have all your limbs. If you go home again, would you look for that little wooden bird? The one you carved with the crooked beak.

choices.text: Are you still worried about me?

voice.speaker: thomas
voice.direction: Warm, plain speech. Quietly proud and worried; never imply adoption or Bladeborn knowledge.
voice.context: Optional return visit. Thomas is the player’s father as far as the player knows; the keepsake is an ordinary childhood carving.

rv.keepsake.later.text: It can wait. I want you back more than I want a bit of wood. Just promise me you are eating something that did not come out of a monster.

choices.text: Actually, tell me where to look.

voice.speaker: thomas
voice.direction: Warm, plain speech. Quietly proud and worried; never imply adoption or Bladeborn knowledge.
voice.context: Optional return visit. Thomas is the player’s father as far as the player knows; the keepsake is an ordinary childhood carving.

rv.keepsake.accepted.text: Our old house is southwest of the village yard. You always hid things where rain could not reach, but muddy boots could. Look behind the house. Finish Homefields before bringing it back here.

voice.speaker: thomas
voice.direction: Warm, plain speech. Quietly proud and worried; never imply adoption or Bladeborn knowledge.
voice.context: Optional return visit. Thomas is the player’s father as far as the player knows; the keepsake is an ordinary childhood carving.

rv.keepsake.wait.text: Behind our old house, southwest of the yard. I remember a plant pot that was always in the way. You called that security. I called it a bruised toe.

voice.speaker: thomas
voice.direction: Warm, plain speech. Quietly proud and worried; never imply adoption or Bladeborn knowledge.
voice.context: Optional return visit. Thomas is the player’s father as far as the player knows; the keepsake is an ordinary childhood carving.

rv.keepsake.deliver.text: You found it. Still crooked. Still my favorite bird. Let me put it here, where I can see it while I wait for you.

voice.speaker: thomas
voice.direction: Warm, plain speech. Quietly proud and worried; never imply adoption or Bladeborn knowledge.
voice.context: Optional return visit. Thomas is the player’s father as far as the player knows; the keepsake is an ordinary childhood carving.

rv.keepsake.thanks.text: There. A small piece of home, even here. Take these coins I set aside. And when this is over, perhaps we can sit down long enough for you to carve another.

voice.speaker: thomas
voice.direction: Warm, plain speech. Quietly proud and worried; never imply adoption or Bladeborn knowledge.
voice.context: Optional return visit. Thomas is the player’s father as far as the player knows; the keepsake is an ordinary childhood carving.

rv.keepsake.worry.text: Of course I am. You could walk in carrying a mountain and I would ask whether you hurt your back. But people came home because you refused to give up. I am proud of you. Both things can be true.

voice.speaker: thomas
voice.direction: A father holding worry and pride together. A small smile, no grand speech.
voice.context: Optional conversation after Keep. No bloodline, adoption or final-battle revelation.

rv.keepsake.home.text: Mend what I can. Make sure the new arrivals have a seat and a hot meal. You are not the only stubborn person in this family.

voice.speaker: thomas
voice.direction: A father holding worry and pride together. A small smile, no grand speech.
voice.context: Optional conversation after Keep. No bloodline, adoption or final-battle revelation.

rv.keepsake.reports.text: They tell me about doors you opened and people you brought back. Some of the stories get taller every time I hear them. The part I believe is that you stopped to help.

voice.speaker: thomas
voice.direction: A father holding worry and pride together. A small smile, no grand speech.
voice.context: Optional conversation after Keep. No bloodline, adoption or final-battle revelation.

effects.title: Food for the Refuge — recovered

effects.title: A Kinder Trail
effects.text: Tracks leave the old grove to the west. Round pads and four toes point toward the trapped animals. One route follows roots; another climbs the low logs.

effects.title: A different visitor
effects.text: These prints have a split hoof. A deer came here for fallen fruit. Follow the four-toed paw marks farther west.

effects.title: Two trails
effects.text: One animal stayed beside the roots. Another trail turns toward the old raised cage. Check both before returning to the Beastkeeper.

effects.title: A trap made safe
effects.text: The animal is free. Check the other trail too. Finish Black Woods to keep this rescue, then report to the Beastkeeper.

effects.title: Both animals are free
effects.text: Finish Black Woods and enter the boss clearing to keep this rescue. Then report to the Beastkeeper in the Waystation. You do not need to lead the animals through the level.

effects.title: The old back step
effects.text: Mud has worn a line past the plant pot behind the house. One board has a small bird scratched into its edge.

effects.title: A familiar hiding place
effects.text: The plant pot slides aside. A loose board covers a shallow space under the back step.

effects.title: The wooden bird
effects.text: The little wooden bird is safe. Finish Homefields and enter Black Woods to keep it. Then bring it to Thomas in the Waystation.
